pages.title: Your Toolkit
pages.text: $(thing)IridescentCraft$() exposes its progression UIs through this Codex rather than cluttering the inventory. Tap the buttons on the next pages to open them directly — no inventory tabs, no keybind hunting.$(br2)$(item)Stats$() — view every attribute affecting you right now (Apothic).$(br2)$(item)Aptitudes$() — level individual aptitudes by spending earned points.

pages.title: Stats
pages.text: Opens the full attribute breakdown: armor, toughness, KB resist, spell power, mana, cooldowns, and every other modifier currently applied to your character.

pages.title: Aptitudes
pages.text: Opens the aptitude tree. Spend earned points on Strength / Constitution / Agility / Intelligence skill paths, or browse passive perks unlocked at each level.
